blocks.testCode:
import unittest
class TestRoom(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        # We assume student fills Room
        r = Room()
        p1 = Person("A", 100)
        p2 = Person("B", 200)
        r.add(p1)
        r.add(p2)
        self.assertEqual(r.shortest().name, "A")
